description: This file configures a Mazda Miata NB engine in a fuel management system. It sets engine parameters, thermistor configurations, ADC channels, pin assignments for relays and sensors, and other engine-specific settings.

methods.name: setMazdaMiataNb1EngineConfiguration
methods.description: Configures engine parameters such as RPM limit, injection modes, trigger type, thermistor settings, ADC channels, and pin assignments specific to Mazda Miata NB engine.
